starlit_stocking.tagline: A wool stocking, a string of starlight and hope.
starlit_stocking.description: Santa's starter trap: a darned stocking laced with a strand of tiny star-lights. It cinches shut when something small climbs in after the glow.
starlit_stocking.backstory: Every new hunter gets one, fished from the lost-property basket by the big fireplace. The drawstring is a thread of light spun from the star on top of the first tree the elves ever decorated, and shadowy hexed elves can't stand to be near it. It won't hold a big one, but little ones still crawl in, hoping the glow is something shiny to steal.

jack_in_the_box.tagline: Wind it up. Wait. Pop goes the elf.
jack_in_the_box.description: A crank-handled toy box whose clockwork lid slams shut the moment curious fingers lift the latch.
jack_in_the_box.backstory: The Toy Workshop made these by the thousand until one swallowed an elf's mitten. Rather than scrap the batch, the elves reversed the springs so the lid snaps shut instead of open. Hexed elves simply cannot stand not knowing what is inside a box, which is the whole idea.

star_lantern.tagline: One fallen star, one brass lantern, no escape.
star_lantern.description: A brass lantern holding a fallen star. When a hexed elf creeps close, the shutters snap open and the beam pins it where it stands.
star_lantern.backstory: Every few winters a star drifts down over the North Pole, and the elves catch it in a mitten before it melts the snow. Kept in a lantern it burns for years. Scrinch's soot loves shadow, and a beam of real starlight is the one thing his hexed elves can't wriggle out of. The lamplighter elves trade the old stars for new ones each Christmas Eve.

icicle_jar.tagline: Cold glass, a sweet smell, a quick freeze.
icicle_jar.description: A jar grown from a single icicle. Its frosty sparkle lures hexed elves in, and the lid freezes shut behind them.
icicle_jar.backstory: The icicles hanging from the lair's north eaves never melt, and nobody quite knows why. The elves found that one snapped off and hollowed out keeps whatever falls inside perfectly chilled. Hexed elves think the glitter means treasure. They are wrong, and then they are cold.

nutcracker_jaws.tagline: Tin soldier outside, steel jaws within.
nutcracker_jaws.description: A towering nutcracker whose painted jaw is driven by a brass mainspring strong enough to crack a walnut, or a hexed elf.
nutcracker_jaws.backstory: This one stood guard by the Workshop doors for a hundred Christmases and never cracked a single nut. When the raids began, the elves rebuilt its innards with springs from Santa's sleigh. It still salutes politely before it bites, which the hexed elves consider very unfair.

constellation_wreath.tagline: Festive on the door, a night sky on the floor.
constellation_wreath.description: A wreath of enchanted wrapping studded with brass-sprung stars. Step inside and every star flares at once, and the ring snaps shut.
constellation_wreath.backstory: Santa's Workshop weaves it from the wrapping Madame Shredwell guarded and pins it with stars on brass springs the Gingerbread Rascals pinched, which the elves find deeply satisfying. Hung on a door it looks like any other wreath. Laid flat, its stars form the shape of the Sleigh, the North Pole's own constellation, and no shadow survives inside it.

snow_globe_prison.tagline: Shake it, and the hexed elf sees only snow.
snow_globe_prison.description: A giant snow globe that swallows its catch whole and swirls it in a blizzard until it forgets which way is out.
snow_globe_prison.backstory: Santa keeps a shelf of snow globes, each holding a tiny winter that is really happening somewhere. This one holds no village, only a storm that never ends. The elves say a hexed elf once spent three days inside it trying to build a snowman to climb out on.

sleigh_bell_snapper.description: The finest trap in the lair: a sleigh-bell harness with a clockwork heart, built on the bones of a Nutcracker Jaws.
sleigh_bell_snapper.backstory: Santa's Workshop rings silver sleighbells rescued from the Stables around a stolen clockwork heart, then fits the whole thing inside a sacrificed Nutcracker Jaws. The bells chime on their own when a hexed elf comes close. Hunters swear it jingles a carol the moment it catches a boss, and only then.

cardboard_box.tagline: Every great hunter started on a box.
cardboard_box.description: A flattened delivery box from the Wrapping Room. It keeps your trap off the cold floor and that is about all.
cardboard_box.backstory: The elves throw out a mountain of these every December, so the first one is free. Look closely and you can still read the shipping label: one rocking horse, to a house that no longer exists. It has carried better things than you, and it will carry you too.

gingerbread_slab.tagline: Firm, fragrant and only slightly nibbled.
gingerbread_slab.description: A thick, oven-hard gingerbread board that steadies a trap and makes the whole set-up smell like a bakery.
gingerbread_slab.backstory: Mrs Claus bakes these as practice before the gingerbread houses, and they come out hard enough to stand on. The scent drifts through the lair and keeps hexed elves coming back for one more sniff. Try not to eat it; hunters who do report the next night's hunt goes badly.

candy_cane_platform.tagline: Striped, sturdy and sweet as a lure.
candy_cane_platform.description: Four giant candy canes lashed into a raft. The peppermint smell draws hexed elves from further down the hall.
candy_cane_platform.backstory: These canes were too long to fit in any stocking, so the elves started building with them instead. The hooked ends make perfect handles for carrying a trap from room to room. Hexed elves cannot resist licking the stripes, which is a good moment to be waiting nearby.

ice_block.tagline: Cut from the oldest ice in the North.
ice_block.description: A clear block quarried from the glacier under the lair. It never melts and never wobbles, so your trap hits true.
ice_block.backstory: Deep under the lair is ice older than Christmas itself. The elves cut a few blocks a year with a saw that sings when it works. Look into one and you can sometimes see bubbles of very old air, and once, the elves insist, a perfectly preserved mince pie.

yule_log_base.tagline: A hearth on four legs, warm and welcoming.
yule_log_base.description: A forged yule log that glows like embers. Its warmth draws hexed elves from all over, and its gears keep your trap steady.
yule_log_base.backstory: Santa's Workshop fits a real yule log with toymaker's gears, ties it with golden ribbon and glazes it in sugar glass. It smoulders gently without ever burning down. Cold, hexed elves come for the warmth, stay for the smell of woodsmoke and cinnamon, and leave on The Naughty List.

toffee_anvil.tagline: Heavy, sticky and impossible to shift.
toffee_anvil.description: A block of hardened toffee shaped like a blacksmith's anvil. It sits so solidly that even the biggest elves can't rock your trap loose.
toffee_anvil.backstory: The Pantry cooks poured this one by accident when a toffee pot boiled over onto an anvil mould. It set before anyone could stop it and has not moved since. Boss-sized elves hate it, mostly because it will not give.

chestnut_brazier.tagline: The smell alone brings them running.
chestnut_brazier.description: A little iron brazier of glowing roast chestnuts. Even a stale cookie smells like a feast beside it.
chestnut_brazier.backstory: A night watchman elf started roasting chestnuts to keep warm and found the hexed elves queuing up. Now it stands guard in the Wrapping Room, crackling away. Hunters on a budget swear by it, and keep a few chestnuts back for themselves.

wishbone_plinth.tagline: Make a wish. The small ones usually come true.
wishbone_plinth.description: A pedestal built from one enormous Christmas wishbone. It adds little muscle but a lot of luck, and common elves rarely get away from it.
wishbone_plinth.backstory: Every year the largest wishbone in the lair is pulled by two elves, and every year the wish is the same: fewer escapes. The winner's half was mounted on a plinth to see if it would help. It does, mostly with the little ones.

sleigh_runner.tagline: Built to haul the heaviest trap the lair has.
sleigh_runner.description: A polished sleigh runner bolted to a toymaker's frame. It carries huge traps and shrugs off the biggest elves, and clockwork traps run best on it.
sleigh_runner.backstory: The Workshop makes these from silver sleigh bells and spare gears when a runner snaps in the Stables. Mounted flat, one makes a base that nothing can tip. Clockwork traps fit its grooves exactly and wind a little tighter.

gingerbread_cottage.tagline: A tiny house nobody can resist.
gingerbread_cottage.description: A whole gingerbread cottage with icing snow and candy windows. The smell draws elves from every corridor, and frost traps keep it fresh.
gingerbread_cottage.backstory: Cookie tins, golden ribbon and a worn Candy Cane Platform are all it takes, plus patience with the icing bag. Hexed elves cannot walk past it without a nibble. The frosting keeps better beside a frost trap, which is why the Stables hunters like it.

wishing_star_pedestal.tagline: Wish on it, then hope the elf wishes harder.
wishing_star_pedestal.description: A pedestal topped with a captured wishing star. It is heavy on luck, so it catches elves that shrug off your trap, and star and carol traps shine on it.
wishing_star_pedestal.backstory: A clockwork heart ticks inside, wrapped in enchanted wrapping and sealed with sugar glass. The star on top grants one small wish per hunt, usually the elf's, and usually that it were somewhere else. Starlight and carol traps make the star sing.

stale_cookie.tagline: Hard as a brick, but hexed elves aren't fussy.
stale_cookie.description: Yesterday's cookies, swept up from the Pantry floor. Cheap, plentiful and good enough for most hexed elves.
stale_cookie.backstory: Santa leaves no cookie behind. The ones that crack, crumble or get licked by a reindeer end up in a sack marked HUNTING. Hexed elves have lost all taste and will chew through a stale cookie as happily as a fresh one, though they grumble about it afterwards.

sugar_cookie.tagline: Fresh from the oven, still a little warm.
sugar_cookie.description: A soft, frosted sugar cookie. It works anywhere, and the sweet smoke draws Sootcap down from the Pantry flues.
sugar_cookie.backstory: Mrs Claus's recipe calls for one pinch of snow from the roof, which may explain why the smell climbs straight up the chimneys. Sootcap comes tumbling down after it, coughing and delighted. Keep a few in your pocket whenever the Pantry fire is lit.

peppermint_bark.description: Slabs of chocolate and crushed peppermint. Its sharp smell cuts through the noise of busy rooms.
peppermint_bark.backstory: The Toy Workshop elves chew this to stay awake through the night shift, and it shows. The smell is so strong it can be tracked through three closed doors and a sleeping reindeer. Hexed elves who catch the scent follow it in a dizzy straight line, which is very convenient for hunters.

fruitcake.tagline: Heavy, dark and irresistible to big troublemakers.
fruitcake.description: A dense fruitcake crafted from candied peel and a Cookie Tin. Rare elves and bosses find it twice as tempting.
fruitcake.backstory: Nobody at the North Pole will admit to liking fruitcake, so the elves bake it only for hunting. Common hexed elves turn up their noses, but the bigger, greedier ones cannot resist anything that rare and that rich. One slice weighs about as much as a small elf.

hot_cocoa.tagline: Steaming, chocolatey, adored by hexed stable hands.
hot_cocoa.description: A mug of thick hot cocoa. Hexed stable hands come running for it; with any other bait they show up half as often.
hot_cocoa.backstory: The stable hands drank cocoa all night to keep warm while the reindeer slept, and the hex made them crave it more than ever. Without a mug steaming nearby, they barely bother leaving the loft. With one, they forget every warning Scrinch ever gave them.

mistletoe_charm.tagline: A little luck, tied with a red ribbon.
mistletoe_charm.description: A sprig of mistletoe that steadies the hunter's hand, adding a touch of luck to every hunt.
mistletoe_charm.backstory: Hang mistletoe over a doorway and something lucky is bound to happen under it. Hunters learned to pin a sprig to their traps instead. The elves craft them in bundles from a sliver of sugar glass, which keeps the leaves green for the whole season.

jingle_bell_charm.tagline: One little bell, a lot of curiosity.
jingle_bell_charm.description: A tiny brass bell that tinkles on its own. Hexed elves can't resist investigating, so more of them come to your trap.
jingle_bell_charm.backstory: These bells fall off reindeer harnesses by the dozen, and the elves gather them up each morning. Hexed elves believe a ringing bell means a sleigh is loading presents nearby. They come sneaking to see, and find your trap waiting instead of a sack of toys.

windup_key_charm.tagline: A few turns more and your trap bites harder.
windup_key_charm.description: A brass wind-up key that slots into any trap and tightens every spring, adding a fifth to its power.
windup_key_charm.backstory: Every toy in the Workshop has one, and the elves have more keys than toys. Somebody discovered that a key fits just as well into a trap, and that three extra turns make a lid slam twice as fast. The elves ask that you return them, and nobody ever does.

candied_peel.tagline: Sticky, sugary and a little bitter.
candied_peel.description: Strips of candied orange peel that hexed elves carry as snacks. A key ingredient for fruitcake.
candied_peel.backstory: Hexed elves steal oranges from the stockings, eat the fruit and stuff the candied peel in their pockets for later. Catch one and the peel spills out everywhere. The Pantry elves will happily take it back to bake into fruitcake.

sugar_glass.tagline: Clear as ice, sweet as candy.
sugar_glass.description: Shards of hardened sugar that rare hexed elves chip from the lair's window panes. Prized by Santa's Workshop.
sugar_glass.backstory: Some windows in Santa's lair are made from boiled sugar, and rare hexed elves cannot help licking and chipping at them. The shards they carry off still hold a little of the lair's magic. Santa's Workshop melts them down to glaze gear and craft charms.

cookie_tin.tagline: Empty, alas. Jarbelly saw to that.
cookie_tin.description: A dented festive cookie tin dropped by Jarbelly the Glutton. Santa's Workshop uses it to bake fruitcake.
cookie_tin.backstory: Jarbelly never goes anywhere without a tin under each arm, and always empty by the time it's caught. The tins are the good old sort, pressed with snowflakes and robins and sealed tight enough to keep a fruitcake moist for a year.

brass_spring.description: A heavy brass spring that Gingerbread Rascals sometimes carry. Santa's Workshop winds it into stronger traps.
brass_spring.backstory: Gingerbread Rascals prise springs out of the Pantry's clockwork mixers and keep them as pogo sticks, which is why they bounce when they run. Catch one and a spring sometimes comes loose. Santa's Workshop has never had better springs.

golden_ribbon.tagline: The ribbon reserved for the best presents.
golden_ribbon.description: A spool of real gold ribbon carried by Spoolwick. Santa's Workshop uses it to bind crafted gear.
golden_ribbon.backstory: Only one present a year is tied with golden ribbon, and nobody knows who gets it. Spoolwick has been stealing spools of it for years to wear as a cape. Bring it back and Santa's Workshop will use it to tie gear that never comes undone.

enchanted_wrapping.description: A self-folding sheet of wrapping paper taken from Madame Shredwell. Woven into the Wreath of Thorns.
enchanted_wrapping.backstory: The Wrapping Room's finest paper folds itself around anything placed on it, then ties its own bow. Madame Shredwell kept a roll to shred for sport but could never quite bring herself to. Elves in Santa's Workshop braid it into thorns that close on command.

toymakers_gear.tagline: Cut by hand, never slips a tooth.
toymakers_gear.description: A master gear Hammerhand pried from the Workshop's great machine. Santa's Workshop needs it for the Yule Log Base.
toymakers_gear.backstory: The great toy machine in the Workshop runs on gears cut by Santa himself, one a year. Hammerhand has been prying them out to stop the line. Each one you bring back keeps a few hundred toys moving, and the spares become very fine gear.

clockwork_heart.description: Foreman Grimbolt's ticking heart of brass and glass. The core of the Sleigh-Bell Snapper.
clockwork_heart.backstory: Grimbolt was once a wooden nutcracker soldier who guarded the Workshop door. Scrinch swapped his heart for one that ticks to a different tune. Catch him and the stolen heart drops free, still ticking. Forged into a trap, it seems to want to catch the elves Scrinch hexed.

silver_sleighbell.description: A real bell from Santa's sleigh harness, worn as a trophy by the Antler Ripper. Rung into the finest traps.
silver_sleighbell.backstory: Santa's sleigh carries exactly one hundred silver bells, and the Antler Ripper has been stealing them one by one to silence the sleigh. Each bell rings a different note. Bring three back and Santa's Workshop can tune them into a trap that sings.

brimstone_coal.tagline: Hot to the touch, and it never goes out.
brimstone_coal.description: A lump of devil's coal broken from Cinderhoof's antlers, smouldering with Scrinch's own fire. Saved for greater gear.
brimstone_coal.backstory: Naughty children get coal. Scrinch's lieutenants carry it as a badge of rank, warmed by the fires under his throne. The elves keep every lump in an iron chest, because Santa's Workshop will one day need fire that hot to make the strongest gear of all.

carol_horn.tagline: One true note, held very loud.
carol_horn.description: A Carol trap made in the Loft. Its song breaks the hex, and it has far more luck than power.
carol_horn.backstory: The Choirmaster's songsheet and a handful of hymn reeds, bound in brass by Santa's Workshop. Blown once, it sings a carol so plainly kind that hexed elves stop to listen and walk into the trap. It is no match for a heavy trap on brute strength, but it rarely misses a small elf.

hymn_reed.tagline: Thin, pale and a little bit musical.
hymn_reed.description: A reed from the carollers' pipes. Six of them are needed for a Carol Horn.
hymn_reed.backstory: Every hexed caroller in the Loft carries a reed, and every one is bent. Straightened and dried by the Workshop, they still hum faintly when the wind is right.

carol_songsheet.tagline: The one tune the hex can't drown out.
carol_songsheet.description: A torn sheet of carol music from Choirmaster Hollowvoice. It goes into a Carol Horn.
carol_songsheet.backstory: The Choirmaster has sung the same flat note since the hex took hold, and he guards the real music so nobody can remind him how it goes. The notes on this sheet are in pencil, and someone has written please stop in the margin.

ribbon_candy.tagline: Striped like the ribbons it was made beside.
ribbon_candy.description: A chewy candy bait made in Santa's Workshop. Draws the Wrapping Room's Glitterbug and Spoolwick, who ignore plain cookies.
ribbon_candy.backstory: The elves noticed that the fussier hexed elves in the Wrapping Room only stole sweets that matched the paper. So they twisted Sugar Twists and Candied Peel into candy striped like ribbon. Glitterbug cannot resist anything that sparkles, and Spoolwick likes anything it can unroll.

golden_bow_bonbon.tagline: Too pretty to eat. Madame Shredwell disagrees.
golden_bow_bonbon.description: A gilded bonbon tied with Golden Ribbon. The only bait Madame Shredwell will come out for.
golden_bow_bonbon.backstory: Madame Shredwell turns her nose up at cookies and candy alike. What she wants is a present worth shredding: a bonbon of Sugar Glass, wrapped in Golden Ribbon and tied in a perfect bow. Leave one on a trap and she arrives at once, scissors first.

sugar_twist.tagline: A curl of pulled sugar, a little sticky.
sugar_twist.description: Common Wrapping Room elves carry these. Mixed with Candied Peel in Santa's Workshop, they make Ribbon Candy.
sugar_twist.backstory: The hexed wrappers twist leftover sugar into curls and keep them in their pockets like spare ribbon. Catch one and a Sugar Twist usually falls out, slightly fluffy. The loyal Workshop elves blow off the fluff and turn them into Ribbon Candy.

tin_whistler.tagline: Whistles through a dented tin pipe.
tin_whistler.description: A Loft common. It follows any clockwork sound across the rafters and can't resist a wound spring.
tin_whistler.backstory: The Tin Whistler once tuned the Workshop's music boxes. The hex left it with one dented pipe and a habit of whistling at the springs inside every toy. A wound spring makes it forget the tune and follow the ticking.
tin_whistler.rumour: A thin, wrong whistle from the rafters, always one note off.

hoarse_caroller.tagline: Wrapped in three scarves and still croaking.
hoarse_caroller.description: A Loft common with a very sore throat. It heads for anything icy, and Frost soothes it long enough to catch.
hoarse_caroller.backstory: The Hoarse Caroller sang so many carols so badly that its voice gave out. Nothing helps except something cold on the throat, so the cold draws it down, and the cold is what catches it.
hoarse_caroller.rumour: A scratchy croak where a carol should be, near the cold window.

mistletoe_mumbler.tagline: Mumbles into a sprig of mistletoe.
mistletoe_mumbler.description: A shy Loft common that hides in the dark. It squints at starlight and creeps closer for a better look.
mistletoe_mumbler.backstory: The Mumbler used to hang the mistletoe over Santa's doorways and now mumbles nonsense to it. It hates being looked at but loves a small bright star, so it creeps out of the shadows towards it.
mistletoe_mumbler.rumour: A mumbled, muffled tune from a dark corner, and a whiff of mistletoe.

silver_piper.tagline: Plays a pipe made of cold silver.
silver_piper.description: A rare Loft elf. Its pipe plays the hex's tune, but a Carol trap throws it off and it stumbles.
silver_piper.backstory: The Silver Piper was the Choir's best player. The hex gave it a silver pipe that plays a note only elves can hear, and it has led more than one apprentice into the rafters. It is the first to lose its place when someone plays a carol true.
silver_piper.rumour: A glint of silver and a note you feel in your teeth.

choirmaster_hollowvoice.tagline: Conducts a choir that left long ago.
choirmaster_hollowvoice.description: The Loft's mini boss. A tall hexed conductor. A Carol trap makes him lose the beat, and clockwork ticks only annoy him.
choirmaster_hollowvoice.backstory: Choirmaster Hollowvoice still waves his baton at an empty loft and sings a flat note to nobody. His songsheet holds the last real carol in the lair, and he guards it from everyone, including himself. Springs and ticking spoil his beat, so Clockwork is useless against him, but the right tune will stop him dead.
choirmaster_hollowvoice.rumour: One enormous flat note, and a baton tapping on a music stand.

crumb_elf.tagline: Small, quick and covered in crumbs.
crumb_elf.description: A hexed baker's boy who nibbles every cookie it finds. It has no real weakness, so any trap will do.
crumb_elf.backstory: Crumb Elves were the Pantry's youngest bakers, sent to sweep the floors. One sniff of Scrinch's soot and they started eating the sweepings instead. They are too simple to fall for one kind of trap more than another, but they never stop coming back for more.
crumb_elf.rumour: Something has been taking one bite from every cookie in the jar.

sprinkle_snatcher.description: A jittery hexed baker who strips the sprinkles off iced biscuits. A sudden spring makes it leap straight into Clockwork traps.
sprinkle_snatcher.backstory: Before the hex, the Sprinkle Snatchers decorated every biscuit in the Pantry. Now they hoard the sprinkles in their pockets and rattle when they run. They are so jumpy that a Jack-in-the-Box springing open sends them leaping the wrong way, straight into the box.
sprinkle_snatcher.rumour: The iced biscuits are bare, and a trail of rainbow dots leads to the skirting board.

sootcap.tagline: First to breathe the soot. Still coughing.
sootcap.description: The first elf Scrinch's soot touched, lurking in the Pantry flues. It hides in shadow, so Starlight shows it up. Sugar cookies lure it down.
sootcap.backstory: Sootcap was sweeping the Pantry chimney the night Scrinch blew his brimstone soot down it. The elf came out black from cap to boots and has grumbled ever since. It lives in the dark of the flues now, and a beam of starlight leaves it nowhere to hide.
sootcap.rumour: Black handprints on the oven door, and the smell of burnt sugar.

gingerbread_rascal.tagline: Run, run, as fast as it can.
gingerbread_rascal.description: A rare gingerbread man the hex brought to life, still warm from the oven. Cold cracks its icing and slows it right down, so bring Frost.
gingerbread_rascal.backstory: When the soot drifted over Mrs. Claus's cooling racks, one gingerbread man sat up, stretched and bit the elf beside it. The Gingerbread Rascal has been running ever since, still warm from the oven. It pockets springs from the mixers to bounce faster, but a blast of frost cracks its icing and stops it dead.
gingerbread_rascal.rumour: One of the gingerbread men on the rack blinked.

jarbelly.tagline: Ate the cookie jar. Then the jar.
jarbelly.description: A greedy hexed pastry chef who eats bait off traps. It reaches into anything that looks like a jar, so Clockwork lids snap shut on it.
jarbelly.backstory: Jarbelly ran the Pantry's pastry ovens and tasted everything twice. The hex turned tasting into gobbling, and now it raids traps for their bait. It cannot pass a lidded box without sticking a hand in, which is exactly what a Jack-in-the-Box is waiting for.
jarbelly.rumour: Cookies vanish from set traps without a single crumb left behind.

ribbon_tangler.tagline: Ties knots for the fun of it.
ribbon_tangler.description: A giggling hexed wrapper who knots every ribbon in reach. Frost freezes its ribbons stiff, and it ends up stuck in its own knot.
ribbon_tangler.backstory: Ribbon Tanglers once tied the neatest bows in the lair. The hex left them giggling and tying everything to everything else. They wear so much ribbon that a frosty trap freezes the lot solid, trapping the Tangler in its own handiwork. Shiny traps barely distract them; they are too busy knotting.
ribbon_tangler.rumour: All the ribbon spools have been tied into one enormous knot.

tape_biter.description: A hexed wrapper with a taste for sticky tape. Like the Wrapping Room's other elves, it can't look away from Starlight.
tape_biter.backstory: Tape Biters used to cut tape for the wrapping benches and lick the ends to keep them neat. Now they chew the whole roll. Years of making presents sparkle left them unable to resist anything that shines, so a beam of starlight stops them mid-chew.
tape_biter.rumour: Every roll of tape has teeth marks, and none of it sticks any more.

bow_burglar.tagline: Takes the bow, the bait and runs.
bow_burglar.description: A masked hexed wrapper who steals bows and bait. It can't pass up a shine, so Starlight catches it, but it slips past Clockwork lids.
bow_burglar.backstory: The Bow Burglar tied the bows on Santa's own presents before the hex. Now it wears a mask and steals them back, along with any bait it can grab. It knows every trick of a spring lid, but a gleam of starlight looks like the shiniest bow in the world.
bow_burglar.rumour: Presents keep turning up wrapped but bow-less.

glitterbug.description: A rare hexed wrapper coated in glitter and mad for anything that shines. Starlight holds it spellbound; it nimbly dodges Clockwork.
glitterbug.backstory: Glitterbug looked after the Wrapping Room's glitter, and the hex made it love sparkle more than anything. It rolls in every spill and dives at every bauble. Show it real starlight and it simply stares. Ribbon Candy, striped like the paper, is the only sweet fancy enough to tempt it out.
glitterbug.rumour: One of the baubles on the Wrapping Room tree keeps moving.

spoolwick.tagline: Wears stolen golden ribbon as a cape.
spoolwick.description: The Wrapping Room's mini boss, a hexed spool-keeper in a golden ribbon cape. Starlight blazes off the cape and blinds it; springs it snips.
spoolwick.backstory: Spoolwick kept the golden ribbon saved for Santa's most special presents, and the hex made it keep the ribbon for itself. It wears it as a cape and snips through any spring with its needle. Starlight catches on all that gold and dazzles it. Only proper sweets like Ribbon Candy lure it from the shelves.
spoolwick.rumour: A flash of gold rolling between the shelves, too fast to follow.

madame_shredwell.description: Scrinch's lieutenant in the Wrapping Room, once its head wrapper, with scissor fingers. She snips clockwork, but a true carol stops her scissors.
madame_shredwell.backstory: Madame Shredwell ran the Wrapping Room with a ruler and a stopwatch. Scrinch's soot turned her love of neat paper into a love of shredding it. She guards the enchanted wrapping meant for Santa's own sack, and only a Golden Bow Bonbon tempts her down. Her scissors make short work of springs, and starlight only glints off the blades. Only a carol sung true makes her drop them.
madame_shredwell.rumour: Confetti everywhere, scissors snipping, and one hummed note she can't stand.

cog_pincher.tagline: Steals one cog. The whole toy stops.
cog_pincher.description: A sneaky hexed toymaker who pockets gears from half-built toys. It can't resist a wind-up, so it reaches straight into Clockwork traps.
cog_pincher.backstory: Cog Pinchers built the insides of every wind-up toy. The hex left them unable to stop fiddling: they prise gears loose just to see what happens. Set a Clockwork trap and a Cog Pincher will be inside it within minutes, trying to take it apart.
cog_pincher.rumour: Wind-up toys keep stopping halfway across the bench.

paint_smudger.tagline: Every rocking horse gets a moustache.
paint_smudger.description: A messy hexed painter who ruins fresh paint jobs in the dark. Starlight shows up every smudge and stops it cold.
paint_smudger.backstory: Paint Smudgers once painted rosy cheeks on every doll. Hexed, they creep out after the lamps go down and paint moustaches on everything instead. They are the one Workshop elf who works by night, and a beam of starlight catches them brush in hand.
paint_smudger.rumour: Every doll in the Workshop has woken up with a painted moustache.

stuffing_ripper.description: A sharp-clawed hexed toymaker who rips the stuffing out of soft toys. Padded with wool, it shrugs off Frost, but Clockwork jaws pin it.
stuffing_ripper.backstory: Stuffing Rippers sewed every teddy bear in the lair. The hex turned their needles into claws, and now they unstuff the bears and line their own coats with the wool. All that padding keeps the cold out, but a clockwork jaw closes before the claws can work.
stuffing_ripper.rumour: Teddy bears lying flat on the shelf, and tufts of white fluff on the floor.

windup_elf.tagline: Wound up and never runs down.
windup_elf.description: A rare clockwork toy elf the hex set walking, with a key in its back. Clockwork traps jam it; frost can't touch it.
windup_elf.backstory: The Workshop made a clockwork elf to show children how elves work. When Scrinch's soot reached the display shelf, the toy wound its own key and walked off. Its tin body doesn't feel the cold at all, but a Clockwork trap tangles its gears and stops it mid-tick.
windup_elf.rumour: A ticking sound that walks around the Workshop at night, all by itself.

hammerhand.tagline: One fist is a mallet. So is the other.
hammerhand.description: The Workshop's mini boss, a hulking hexed smith with hammer hands. Still hot from the forge, he cools down fast in a Frost trap.
hammerhand.backstory: Hammerhand worked the Workshop forge, beating out runners for sleighs. The hex fused his hammers to his hands and his temper to the furnace. He stomps about checking the orders, glowing hot, and the one thing that slows him is a trap cold enough to make him steam.
hammerhand.rumour: Thumps from inside the great toy machine, and a gear rolling out on the floor.

general_grimbolt.tagline: Once a toy. Now Scrinch's general.
general_grimbolt.description: Scrinch's lieutenant in the Workshop, a hexed nutcracker soldier drilling the toy army. Clockwork out-ticks him; frost bounces off.
general_grimbolt.backstory: Grimbolt was a wooden nutcracker soldier who stood guard by the Workshop door. Scrinch swapped his heart for a clockwork one that ticks to a different tune and gave him a general's coat. Now he drills the toys at night. Frost bounces off his painted wood, but a Clockwork trap ticks faster than his heart and catches him out of step.
general_grimbolt.rumour: Marching footsteps in perfect time, but the toy soldiers are all on their shelf.

hay_hoarder.description: A drowsy hexed stable hand who burrows into warm hay. One frosty breath and it bolts, so Frost traps catch it. Hot cocoa lures it out.
hay_hoarder.backstory: Hay Hoarders forked fresh hay into the stalls every morning. Since the hex they feel cold all the time, so they burrow into the bales and eat the reindeer feed. A chill sends them scrambling for the nearest warm spot, which is a bad moment to find a Frost trap there.
hay_hoarder.rumour: The hay bales are hollow, and one of them snores.

bell_thief.description: A hexed stable hand who steals bells and bait. It hates the cold, so Frost catches it, but it shuts its eyes against starlight.
bell_thief.backstory: Bell Thieves polished the harness bells until they shone. The hex left them wanting the bells for themselves, and now they creep about with pockets full of jingle. They learned to squint against the glare off the snow, so starlight barely bothers them, but cold sends them running.
bell_thief.rumour: The harness bells have gone quiet, because there are no bells left on them.

harness_snipper.tagline: Snip, snip, there goes the sleigh.
harness_snipper.description: A hexed stable hand with shears who cuts reindeer harnesses. Its shears catch in springs, so Clockwork works best; starlight it ignores.
harness_snipper.backstory: Harness Snippers trimmed the reindeer straps to just the right length. Hexed, they cut every strap they can find. They are the one stable hand who doesn't mind the cold, after years in the open harness shed, but their shears snag in a Clockwork trap's springs every time.
harness_snipper.rumour: Neat cuts in every harness strap, and frost-cold footprints in the straw.

carrot_crook.tagline: Every carrot in the stable, gone.
carrot_crook.description: A rare hexed stable hand who hoards the reindeers' carrots by the warm stove. Frost catches it best; starlight barely slows it.
carrot_crook.backstory: The Carrot Crook used to hand out carrots at feeding time. Now it keeps them all in a warm nest behind the stable stove. Cold is the one thing it truly fears, and it has squinted into the snow glare so long that starlight hardly registers.
carrot_crook.rumour: The reindeer are hungry and there is an orange stain leading up to the loft.

antler_ripper.description: The Stables' mini boss, a hexed elf wearing stolen antlers and sleighbells. Frost sends it shivering; starlight barely slows it down.
antler_ripper.backstory: Antler Ripper always wished it could fly with the reindeer. The hex turned the wish sour: it ties shed antlers to its cap and steals sleighbells to sound like a reindeer. It makes the other stable hands keep the stove roaring, because one cold draught leaves it shivering in its boots.
antler_ripper.rumour: The sleigh is missing bells, and something with crooked antlers was seen in the loft.

cinderhoof.description: The Stables' boss, a soot-black reindeer with ember antlers, hexed to pull Scrinch's sleigh. Frost douses its embers; starlight dies at its touch.
cinderhoof.backstory: Cinderhoof was the quietest reindeer in Santa's stables until Scrinch lured it away with a sack of brimstone oats. It came back soot-black, with antlers that smoulder like coals, and now it ambushes Santa's sleigh at every launch. The darkness around it swallows starlight, but a trap cold enough to douse its embers brings it down.
cinderhoof.rumour: Scorched hoof-prints by the sleigh, and the star over the stable door has gone dark.
